connections.why: Cell-membrane structure controls osmosis and transport in and out of cells
DNA in the nucleus must be copied when cells divide by mitosis
Glucose made in photosynthesis fuels respiration
Plant transport tissues move the water and sugars photosynthesis needs and makes
Enzymes catalyse digestion and the reactions of respiration
The circulatory system delivers oxygen and glucose to respiring cells
Hormones coordinate the menstrual cycle and reproduction
Inherited variation is what natural selection acts on
Genetic engineering manipulates the DNA studied in inheritance
Microorganisms include the pathogens the immune system defends against
Microbes are tools in biotechnology and genetic engineering
Competition within ecosystems drives natural selection
Blood transports the wastes the kidneys filter and excrete
Osmoregulation in the kidney depends on osmosis
Pathogens and white blood cells travel in the blood
